This document outlines the minor 
maintenance procedure P1 (to check leakage from pipes), which must be 
carried out when 
the gas turbine have minor maintenance after 4000 workhour.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf 
Abdel Meniem Fahmy tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla, at 04 
May 
2003 on Boiler no. 2 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel 
Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

The HRSG 
 is out of serves & depressurized the required section.

Drain the 
 the required section after opening the vent valve.

The inlet 
 dampers are closed & locked mechanical when the gas turbine in service.

Disconnect 
 the power supply for the damper actuators.

Seal air 
 fan is in service when the gas turbine in service.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor 
maintenance procedure P1 (to check leakage from pipes), which must be 
carried out when 
the gas turbine have minor maintenance after 4000 workhour.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf 
Abdel Meniem Fahmy tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla, at 04 
May 
2003 on Boiler no. 2 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel 
Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
The HRSG 
 is out of serves & depressurized the required section.
Drain the 
 the required section after opening the vent valve.
The inlet 
 dampers are closed & locked mechanical when the gas turbine in service.
Disconnect 
 the power supply for the damper actuators.
Seal air 
 fan is in service when the gas turbine in service.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

TIG welding machine.
Grinder & grinding wheel.
Selected filler metal for TIG 
 welding.
